intro: Choosing the right area matters more than the hotel itself in Krabi. Here are the main neighborhoods, who each suits, and where to book for your travel style.

blocks.html: Short answer: Most people stay in Ao Nang — the hub for hotels, dining and island-tour boats. For nature, quiet and no cars choose Railay (reachable only by boat); for budget, local life and onward transport pick Krabi Town.

faq.q: Where should I stay in Krabi for a first visit?
faq.a: Ao Nang is best for a first visit — the hub for hotels of all budgets, restaurants and boats to the 4 Islands and Phi Phi, with a walkable beachfront and easy transport.
It suits nature lovers, rock climbers and anyone wanting a quiet, car-free vibe. Railay is reachable only by longtail boat from Ao Nang, with gorgeous limestone-cliff scenery.

faq.q: Where is the cheapest area to stay in Krabi?
faq.a: Krabi Town has cheaper, more local accommodation with a night market and good onward transport, but it is not on a beach — Ao Nang is a 20–30 minute ride away.
